paper_metadata.title: Effect of cobalt on microstructure and properties of AlCr1.5CuFeNi2Cox high-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: The present paper investigates the effect of Co addition on the alloying behaviour, microstructure and the resulting properties of cast AlCr 1.5CuFeNi2Cox high-entropy alloys intended to be used at high temperature application.
